NBA DFS Picks for Friday, November 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Friday, November 6 · 7 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 6, 4:31 PM ET

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) is the top-projected player on the Friday, November 6 DraftKings main slate at 51.1 DraftKings points for $10,200. Cooper Flagg (DAL, 48.7, $9,900) and Jayson Tatum (BOS, 47.9, $10,000) are next.

Collin Murray-Boyles (TOR) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.98 projected points per $1,000 at $4,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 6, 4:31 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
